input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: North elevation dimension chain matches south-facade pixel measurement independently; consistent F1 window height family.

claims.reason: North_view.png right-side vertical dimension chain (top-to-bottom, above the F1/F2 slab line): 400mm (lintel), 1600mm (window height), 1000mm (sill to ground). F1 wall top is absolute z=3.0m (matches assembled F1 ceiling_height). direction=-1 walks downward from that top. Segment index 1 (the 1600mm span) yields the window's absolute z interval. South_view.png pixel measurement of a representative F1 window (view_0031/profile_027: wall outline y189(top,6.6m)-y569(ground,0m); window outer frame y419-511) independently gives head=(569-419)*17.368mm/px=2604mm, sill=(569-511)*17.368=1007mm, confirming the same 1000/1600 family for the south facade too. Applied to all F1 windows (north, south, east) as one consistent height family; no per-window difference was observed.

decision.reason: North and South elevations show identical 800/1800/1000 chain for F2 windows; total matches overall 6600mm building height.

claims.reason: North_view.png right-side vertical dimension chain (top-to-bottom, above the F1/F2 slab line): 800mm (parapet above window), 1800mm (window height), 1000mm (sill to F1/F2 slab). South_view.png shows the identical 800/1800/1000 breakdown for its top row. Absolute building top = z=6.6m (matches overall '6600' elevation label and assembled F1(3.0)+F2(3.6) heights). direction=-1 walks downward from that top; segment index 1 (the 1800mm span) yields the window's absolute z interval [4.0,5.8]. Applied uniformly to all F2 windows (north, south, east, west corridor) as one consistent height family; no per-window difference was observed in any elevation.

decision.reason: South elevation door dimension chain confirms standard 2100mm door height on floor; West elevation shows matching proportioned door graphic.

claims.reason: South_view.png right-side vertical dimension chain for the exterior door column (view_0030): top-to-bottom 900mm (lintel), 600mm+1500mm (door leaf, merged here as a single 2100mm door height matching the standard door height convention; the drawing splits it only to mark a vision-panel/threshold detail line, not two separate openings). Absolute F1 wall top = z=3.0m; direction=-1 from that top; segment index 1 selects the merged 2100mm door span, giving absolute z=[0,2.1], i.e. door sitting on the floor. Applied to both F1 exterior doors (west corridor entrance and south RoomD entrance) since West_view.png shows the same tall door graphic proportions for the west door.
unresolved: Internal 600/1500 split within the 2100mm door leaf (likely a vision panel) not modelled separately.
